items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: I can remember seeing ... the Max Sonnet comedies

ctx.x: Yeah, silent films, you know. We'd play music that was supposed to be appropriate. Half the time we didn't know what we were playing for, you know, but we'd be playing something. I can remember seeing Rudolph Valentino pictures, you know, and the Keystone Cops, you know, the Max Sonnet comedies and all that sort of thing. I used to play for all of that stuff, but with a little group. I didn't play by myself. It was a little combination.
I see. And violin, of course, was a very important instrument, I think, earlier in jazz.
